reviews.author: Lesa
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Charles R Morton Electric! I needed an electrical repair and they were able to get me on the schedule quickly. The technician arrived on time, diagnosed the problem right away, and had everything repaired in no time. He was professional, courteous, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain what was causing the issue. The pricing was fair, and the quality of the work gave me confidence that the repair was done right. It’s hard to find companies that are this responsive and reliable. I highly recommend Charles R Morton Electric and will definitely call them again for any future electrical needs

reviews.author: C Browne
reviews.text: This company is amazing! I called Mr Morton Sunday afternoon. Not only was he able to visit the same day, he arrived earlier than he initially stated. He was professional, knowledgeable and diligent. Although my problem took longer that expected, he patiently answered all my questions. Even explaining what he was doing and had discovered. He fixed my main issue that evening but needed to return to complete the job. He returned early the next morning with Mr. Shephard. I marveled how they went to work. I thought he cloned himself because Mr Shephard was just as diligent and courteous as Mr. Morton. Not only did they fix my problem, I added more work which was done flawlessly by Mr. Sheppard. These guys are/were outstanding. I would recommend using Charles Morton Electric for all your electrical needs! Great job and thanks again. Super work!

reviews.author: Rischard Miles
reviews.text: Mr. Charles and technician Marcus did a fantastic job with installing receptacles in our downstairs area. Marcus was efficient, punctual and exceeded our overall expectation. We will use Mr Morton’s services going forward.

reviews.author: Joy Gatewood
reviews.text: A friend recommended Charles Morton Electric to me. Marcus arrived on time and was extremely professional and friendly. He diagnosed the problem quickly and resolved the issue at a reasonable price the same day. Charles, personally contacted me after the job was performed to make sure I was pleased. I would strongly recommend this company to anyone with electrical concerns.

reviews.author: Deborah Entrekin
reviews.text: Most excellent service! Morton electrical was very professional, knowledgeable, compassionate prompt in every way. Highly highly recommend.

reviews.author: Krishna Omolade
reviews.text: They did a great job installing a Home Depot Ceiling Fan and light. Scheduling was easy, the price was reasonable and the installation was done with alacrity. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Adam Donnelly
reviews.text: Marcus was on time, polite, and efficient. He and Charles took the time to make sure the staircase chandelier was just the right height. We are very pleased and reccomend this team to friends and family. Thank you!

reviews.author: shamillep02
reviews.text: When I tell you Morton Electronic was a lifesaver. I literally knocked out the electricity in my bathroom. When I called for availability they were available the next day. They were on time, professional and even helped me with the other sockets in my room that were loose, and needing to be changed as well. I also needed a light fixture installed in my other bathroom as well. On the fixture that was new, I was missing a piece, but the technician was able to use a different piece and make it work. I was very impressed and happy with my service. Morton Electric will always be my first call!

reviews.author: Kattie Alexander
reviews.text: Charles was prompt , very professional and completed the job in less time than expected. My issue was solved at a reasonable price. I have already recommended this company to a friend, and I will definitely use them again.

reviews.text: Charles was amazing!!! He fixed our problem so quickly and even gave me tips for how to handle things in the future! Will definitely be using him again!

reviews.text: Love Charles and his crew. Always accommodating and do a great job, even when we need to get creative! I'm a Realtor and have used them for years for big and small jobs, personally and with my clients. I highly recommend them.

reviews.text: Extremely Professional, Efficient, ON TIME!!, Patient and Knowledgeable! I asked for extra business cards to share with my friends! Would definitely hire again… Hope I won’t need to, but if I did, they are my FIRST Call!

reviews.text: Online inquiry with prompt response from Charles. Clear communication, detailed quote with fair pricing and excellent work. Work included 8 recessed lights with some on a dimmer, new outdoor wall sconce

reviews.author: Felecia K.
reviews.text: Charles is now apart of my get done team. He was quick and have is what it meant to have one breaker as opposed to the other. He came in completed the task and was out. Thank you Charles

reviews.author: Gabrielle Dudley
reviews.text: 2024 Edit: I was running both a heater and blow dryer in my bathroom and blew a fuse. I did all of the YouTube video and Google suggestions, but I could not get it to come back on. I put in an online request and heard back very quickly. Once I explained the issue to Mr. Morton, he was kind enough to walk me through how to do it myself instead of charging me $200+ to come out. He could have easily taken advantage of me, but he was honest and kind. This business will ALWAYS be my first call for anything electrical. A few years after my initial review, but still 5 star service. -- I was seeking an electrician to add an outdoor outlet and one of my neighbors recommended Morton Electrical via Nextdoor. I completed the online form and I received a call from the owner within 10 seconds - I was so shocked. Mr. Morton was very friendly and quoted me a fair price. He was able to schedule me for two days later though because of the bad storms it needed to be rescheduled for the next day. Michael arrived on time, followed COVID protocols, and quickly walked me through the work he needed to do. The work was completed in about 30 minutes and it looks so nice and professional. I highly recommend this company for your next electrical project!

reviews.author: Jason Lusk
reviews.text: Charles made it very easy to confirm an appointment, and Marcus provided an expert pendulum light installation. They will be my go-to electricians for any home projects.

reviews.text: I used Charles's electrical service over 1 year ago to completely wire our basement which we decided to finish. This included wiring for heating and air systems as well. His crew was timely and did an excellent job with the installation. He provided excellent service and made really good suggestions regarding outlet placement and lighting. We have been extremely happy with the results. To this day swe haven't had any electrical issues, everything is working fine. I would highly recommend his services to anyone needing electrical work to be done.

reviews.author: Rabiah Morning-Parker
reviews.text: Used Charles twice and excellent service both times. The mounting was precise and price was reasonable. Thanks again!!

reviews.author: John McConnell
reviews.text: He was quick to come Come in and identify the problem. Solved just as quickly. He was very easy to talk to. I wouldn’t go anywhere else with an electrical issue.

reviews.author: Eric Williams
reviews.text: Quick response time. Charles Morton Electrical Service provided me with Professional & Excellent Service. Charles recommended the exact service I needed. I will be using Morton Electric for all of my Electrical needs.

reviews.author: Ann McClain
reviews.text: Would recommend Morton Electric to anyone experiencing these type of issues. We have had grounding wire/cable installed; outlet for garage door opener and other issues. Marcus (technician) came in, identified and resolved problem without hesitation. He is always pleasant and professional. We have been 100% satisfied with prompt and efficient service.

reviews.author: morgan alexander
reviews.text: So I noticed that lights were out in basically one half of my house. I woke up the next morning and googled electrians , this company popped up. I read through reviews and did some other digging and decided to give them a call. I’m glad I did. Charles came out later that afternoon and began to troubleshoot in the areas where there lights weee not coming on. He was so thorough in understanding the root cause of the issue. He always was very detailed in sharing with me everything he was seeing and how he planed to rectify the situation. I was appreciative of that and joked with my mom that i needed a note book to write down all the info b/c he was giving me a crash course. Ultimately he was able to find the fault and fix the problem. He re-routed circuits making sure that rooms that were affected would be able to work o their own circuits. The job was quite tedious due to the poor wiring job that had been done in the past in the house. We had one additional piece to complete which was getting the ceiling fan in my living room reconnected to power. Marcus a team member came out and completed that today. He was wonderful as well and careful not to damage any of items. Overall I will definitely use this company again and recommend them to others. A+ and timely customer service, friendly and personable staff.

reviews.author: Cynthia McLeod Kamasa-Quashie
reviews.text: Awesome job each time I have needed the services of Charles Morton Electric, LLC. Marcus does a great job, always dependable. Satisfaction guaranteed!

reviews.author: Michelle Dennison
reviews.text: What a wonderful experience! Marcus was able to complete all the work in just a few hours. He was professional and friendly. Quite simply, lovely.

reviews.author: Jenny
reviews.text: Great service from Charles today. I had a no nonsense estimate of costs for the jobs I needed done. He made an appointment, came out on time, and retrofitted two florescent fixtures into LED, installed two smoke detectors, and replaced a socket. No pressure trying to get me to agree to repairs unneeded. Just straight up did the jobs I asked, at the price quoted. Very honest and straightforward. I'm very satisfied with the service and will use him again. I can't say enough good things about his service, and trust I have in him.

reviews.text: Great service..Promt Attention..Very Dependable. Had the opportunity to use this company’s services a few times. His team is definitely detailed oriented and very efficient. Will definitely call when in need. Thanks

reviews.text: We loved working with Charles and have already recommended him to some friends! (Covid plus: he happily wore a mask without us having to ask.) Morton Electric will definitely be our go-to!

reviews.author: Michael “MIXZO” Johnson
reviews.text: Top tier service! Punctual, knowledgeable, and professional. I was very impressed with my results. I can’t say enough. The whole team respected my home and was very respectful of my time. Will be using them for all of my electrical needs. A++++

reviews.author: Jayme Johnson
reviews.text: I sent in a service request, received a call from Mr. Morton early the next day and he gave me great information. He was very knowledgeable in his craft. I was scheduled for the service same day. The electrician came promptly and was very professional. My issue was resolved quickly!! I highly recommend this company!!!

reviews.author: Van Dixon
reviews.text: I'm very satisfied with the service and professionalism. I had previously received a quote for twice as much as I paid Charles R Morton Electric. I'm willing to pay for quality service. But don't try to rip me off. All services were clearly explained. Cost saving options were presented and empliminted. Corrections were made to existing outside outlets that were causing problems that I was not made aware of with previous quotes. I now have outlets to handle all tools for my new workshop in my garage. I highly recommend Charles R Morton Electric.

reviews.author: Bruce Nelson
reviews.text: Great Service by Charles Morton! Top-notch professional. Highly recommended for Electrical Services.

reviews.author: melissa rodriguez
reviews.text: I hired Morton Electric to come out and do an inspection. Mr. Morton were very pleasant and polite from the first call. I didn't have to wait a long time for an appointment. They arrived on time and looked very professional. It didn't take them long to find my problem and they were able to fix it that day at a very reasonable price. I was informed throughout the process of everything that was going on, so there were no surprises. Mr. Morton was very knowledgeable and was able to break things down so that I could understand them with my limited electrical knowledge. I can truly say I was very impressed with the service provided and I will be recommending them to all of my friends, family and associates.

reviews.author: Mary Howard Ade
reviews.text: Charles is very friendly and professional. He made a last minute service request to my house during the holidays and went out of his way to inspect more than I originally asked for. He has a clear knowledge of his line of work and seems to want the best for his customers and gives honest feedback. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Shalonda Graham
reviews.text: Charles is very friendly, professional, and knowledgeable. I needed an outlet installed in my garage. So I called around to several electricians inquiring about prices and the service involved. Charles impressed me over the phone with describing exactly what he can do, and not trying to oversell me with unnecessary services. He came to my house and did exactly what he said. The outlet works great!! I will definitely use him again if I have any more electrical needs.

reviews.author: Brandi Thomas
reviews.text: We hired Charles and his team to install a whole house electric generator and we couldn’t be happier with the results. He and his team were thorough and professional and didn’t quit until it was done exactly right. If I reach out to him, he is responsive, often within minutes. I would recommend him to anyone who needs electrician services.

reviews.author: Oh well
reviews.text: I am very happy I contacted Charles through a recommendation on nextdoor neighbor. Charles did not disappoint. His response for very quick. Sometimes you are left waiting for days for a return call, not so with Charles, he reached out immediately and scheduled time within one day. Charles is professional, courteous, thorough and educated me on the source of my issue. Again, I am very glad I contacted this business for my needs and will definitely refer this company to others. This is my new source for my electrical needs going forward!

reviews.author: Lauren and Keith Silberman
reviews.text: I've actually never written an online review before but wanted to leave one here for Charles. The entire experience was fantastic from start to finish. I am a real estate agent and deal with contractors all the time and absolutely loved dealing with Charles Morton electric. Charles has been incredibly responsive and able to meet me really quickly to take care of an issue that came up on a client's inspection report. He assessed the issue (which actually wasn't an issue) and wrote up an invoice to reassure the buyers that there was not an issue but rather a problem with the inspector's GFCI tester. I am very thankful that I found him and he will definitely get my business again.

reviews.author: Vaughn Hill
reviews.text: Without a doubt when I need any type of electrical work done I go straight to Charles Morton. Sometimes I feel like he gets tired of me calling and messaging him about issues or new projects, but he’s always excited to work with me, extremely professional, punctual, and reasonable. His quality of work is outstanding and I have never had an issue. You will be pleased.

reviews.author: Katrina Walker
reviews.text: Mr. Morton and his associate Michael did an awesome job installing my chandelier. Michael was extremely professional and was very knowledgeable. With that said, I highly recommend Charles Morton Electric, LLC if you are in need of a skilled and professional electrician. As a seasoned home owner, an electrician of this caliber will be on my FIRST list on contacts if any issues arise on my properties. Thank you for your partnership! I sincerely appreciate your timely response to my service request. Mrs. Walker

reviews.author: Paulette PeEk
reviews.text: I am so glad that GOD led me to contact Charles R Morton Electric. I saw a spark and heard a pop when I turned a light switch on, and then noticed loss of some lights in my home. I contacted them right before closing and Mr Morton was even willing to come by on his way home. I requested a next day appointment instead. Just as promised his employee Daniel arrived the next morning on time. He was very professional, knowledgeable, personable, and followed COVID precautions by wearing his face mask. He informed me of the problem and showed me the damage to the outlet, wire, & switch. He replaced the outlet, switch, and repaired the wire. He answered my questions and made sure all lights were working before he left. I was so pleased with this company and informed Mr Morton that I will be using them in the future for my ceiling fan installs and other projects. I will also refer them to everyone looking for A+ rated electricians. Thank you Charles and Daniel.

reviews.author: Carl bell
reviews.text: I had electrical work done on my home by Charles and his technician Marcus and was extremely satisfied with the price and work done!!!

reviews.author: Aimée Taylor
reviews.text: I HAVE FOUND MY ELECTRICIAN!!!! Charles and Mike were great! All I needed was a new 240v outlet installed. Charles is on it. Great, friendly, smily, responsive, and professional. You can tell he takes pride in his work and he makes sure it's done right. Before arriving he asked questions to clarify what was needed and to make sure they had the right gear before showing up, always called before showing up, and on time. They also where able to answer all my questions as well. They even had a vacuum to clean up the sawdust! You might not need an electrician often but for the times that I do, I know who I'm calling! Do you?

reviews.author: Khaliah Teal
reviews.text: I have nothing but good things to say about this company and their service. I called on a Sunday expecting to leave a voicemail and to my surprise I actually spoke to someone live. He asked several questions to assist in diagnosing my issue and then we set the appointment date and time window. The day of the appointment I received a call to advise that the electrician was on his way and it was within the time frame I was quoted previously. It took him no time to locate and repair the problem. If I ever have any electrical needs I will definitely call again. They are prompt, courteous, professional, and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Twilynya Cloud
reviews.text: I would highly recommend Charles of Morton Electric for all your electrical needs. He is very knowledgeable, professional, and timely. I need him to put up my fans , added a surge protector for my fuse box, add an outlet in the garage to charge the car. I was very pleased with all his work and the timely manner it was done in. He pricing is fair and if something else need to be done he will give the option and explain everything in detail so you understand. I really like the work ethic he has and would use when ever I needed anything electrical done!!!! I would not go to anyone else!!! Thx Charles!!!

reviews.author: No Longer Maintained
reviews.text: Professional, polite, friendly, and reasonably priced. I had him install a flood light on the side of my house. There was no wiring, so he had to wire the area before installing the light. He set the preferences of the light for me. He was done within about an hour and a half and cleaned up after himself. I have other projects, so I will definitely use him again!

reviews.author: Tia R
reviews.text: 5 stars isn’t enough. I called them at 3:58 pm. The electrician Marcus arrived at 4:57 pm to fix an issue we had with replacing the hardwire outlet with a 4 prong outlet. Great customer service. Great work. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Chris Greenwood
reviews.text: We had a water leak in a refrigerator that flooded into our basement. The dry out contractor had Charles Morton inspect electrical panel. He said the panel needed replacing and the price would be $8200. Things were discussed with my wife in my absence and she left the conversation believing the house would no longer be insurable . I received several estimates for under $2000. They also said there was nothing wrong with the panel and breakers. OK for more details. Reliable Restoration was doing the abatement for the water damage in early August. Charles Morton was used as a sub for the electrical check out. I was told the panel needed replaces. (Ray??) was on site and gave me Charles Morton's phone number. I talked with Mr Morton directly approx August 10th. I asked why so expensive and why it was required. I got a lot of talk about NEMA watertight etc etc etc. I said I would review and let Reliable Restoration know if we were going to move ahead. I received a call from Reliable Restoration wanting the schedule the panel change out. I said I would need a detailed estimate of what he $8200 was covering. That was never received.

reviews.author: Heather Teusch
reviews.text: Unfortunately, my dryer caught on fire last weekend. I got Charles‘s number from a friend of mine. He was quick to respond and set up a date for someone on his team (Michael) to come out and look at the damage. Michael contacted me when he was on his way and was within the window of time expected. He was very polite, went over everything thoroughly, and did a super job. I highly recommend the company and can see why my friends like them so much.

reviews.author: Violeta Parker
reviews.text: I am an extremely satisfied customer. Such timely, professional, courteous, and quality service was provided by the Morton technician dispatched to Stanton Oaks Apartments. I would have gone to him the second time, but a “neighborhood electrician” promised to help us within hours, and Charles couldn’t make it till the next day. Of course the guy fell through and Charles and Mike actually came through the next day. He will be my first call for all electrical matters from now on.
